# A13 — Two Logics of Two — Dia / Syn

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A13′ — The Cut and the Gathering](conjugate/A13-prime-The-Cut-and-the-Gathering.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Difference already occurs within a relation. Before signs are assigned, the slash holds the capacity to distinguish:

$$
/ = -/-.
$$

The [[A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All|two Ones]] have distinct firstness: the singular One and the polyvalent All belong together without becoming interchangeable. Their [[A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many|One/All relation]] gives the two logics their pressure. Comparability precedes opposition: the act that recognises two as opposed has already related them. That common operation remains active even when its products are treated as independent camps.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C18-Apoha|Constitutive exclusion]] keeps excluded alternatives active in the sense of a determination. A boundary selects something real. Its consequence depends on whether the selection retains the field through which it acquired its sense and power.

## #1

Dia-ballein gives the difference direction. Assignment of signs produces a centred polarity:

$$
(-1)/(+1).
$$

Zero remains the axis of tension and connection. Measurement, comparison, refusal, critique, classification, ranking and decision require this capacity to distinguish. A signed direction means through the centre and the counter-direction it has not selected. The pole's local definiteness therefore carries a relation; it does not have to wait for a later reconciliation to acquire one.

The collapse changes the operation performed between the terms:

$$
(-1)+(+1)=0,
$$

$$
(-1)-(+1)=-2,\qquad (+1)-(-1)=+2.
$$

Addition cancels the opposed values. Subtraction measures their whole span from one orientation and attributes that magnitude to its pole. Cancellation and appropriation are therefore different operations, and neither preserves the live polarity of the slash.

QL reads these ordinary arithmetic differences as three distinct relational consequences: held polarity, cancelled opposition, and a span appropriated by one pole. The philosophical force lies in what survives each operation and what becomes unavailable for return.

## #2

The return first meets the determination at the point where it claims to be sufficient. The materialist one takes the manifest mark as the whole of reality. What returns is the condition the mark excluded from its account, and it enters first as a break in the mark's own reckoning. The achieved one turns toward that ground as its own division: `1/0`. Ordinary arithmetic gives this quotient no value. The native operation keeps that inability exact: the determination cannot count the condition of its determining as another determination.

Carrying the break changes what zero does. Cancellation would settle the opposed terms in a terminal zero; appropriation would give their whole span to one pole as `±2`. Here the uncomputed `/0` remains beneath the one. The achieved determination continues to stand, but its ground remains active in how it can be understood and used. That retention is the recognition written `0/1`: the mark is received through the condition it had treated as absent. The return has entered as break before it can be recognised as relation.

Sym-ballein holds those two orientations together. The inner slash works as AND/OR: conjunction retains both terms, disjunction preserves their difference. `0/1` reads the One through its appearing All; `1/0` reads the appearing All toward the One which it cannot contain. Their identity is the relation's identity across its obverse orientations:

$$
0/1 = 1/0,\qquad (0/1)/(1/0).
$$

The outer slash relates those orientations themselves. This is QL relational notation: ordinary arithmetic's defined `0/1` and undefined `1/0` remain the formal seam through which the return operates. The finite expression encounters the condition that cannot be made into another finite expression. Sym-ballein defines towards wholeness by retaining that encounter; a claim to possess wholeness would close the return it names.

The distinction's self-relation can now be counted. The two singles `{0,1}` remain, together with their four pairings `{00,01,10,11}`:

$$
2+2^2=2+4=6=4+2.
$$

The four pairings do not replace the original two. The sixfold holds both the poles and the ways their relation can relate itself. This is why the two logics yield a process body: the achieved determination can become accountable to its source and inverse rather than end at its output.

## #3

The complete computational pulse is **divide / relate / recombine / return**. Recursive division makes subproblems tractable because their answers can be recomposed. If the capacity to combine is retained privately while everyone else remains divided, division becomes a means of governing the gap. That political extension concerns the ownership of the relating office, including institutions, labour, material conditions and coercion; a psychological description alone cannot establish its historical instances.

Q27's “two monocultures” gives the failure a precise recurrence. Each camp suppresses its internal plurality, needs the other as its negative identity, treats internal dissent as contamination, and reads the other's hardening as confirmation that further exclusion is necessary. More visible antagonism then coexists with less Poly. This [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation|counter-generation]] makes the opposed camp a condition of each camp's hardened identity; a [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|local arbitration regime]] decides which contrary evidence can count within it. The return asks what field was divided and who controls its recomposition. “Divine and concur” recovers that third relation; it does not calculate a midpoint between the camps. Judgment of unequal facts, power and responsibility remains possible within the recovered field.

A problem can close when its stated task is resolved. A constitutive predicament persists because each pole supplies something the other needs. Forced restabilisation treats the latter as though one final answer could discharge it, expelling the relation as a remainder. [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|Arbitration]] becomes usurpation where the closing authority makes its own measure unavailable to the relation it judges. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C23-Severance|Severance]] loses the field through exclusion; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C24-Fusion|fusion]] loses difference through enforced coincidence. Their [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C25-Counterfeit-Gathering|counterfeit gathering]] meets in a comprehensive enclosure which claims to be a living whole while withholding the return that could change its measure.

## #4

The whole mythic relation figures how gathering can either preserve or arrest differentiated powers. Ares gives refusal, defence and the capacity to remain distinct; Aphrodite gives attraction and meeting. Harmonia carries the form their relation can generate while retaining tension. Hesiod's genealogy also includes Panic and Fear, so the ancient family cannot be reduced to a guarantee that union produces concord. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/hesiod/hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white/hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white|Hesiod's genealogy]], 933–937, the children make the parents' relation consequential in different ways; the two-logics reading develops how gathering can preserve differentiated powers.

Hephaestus's bonds gather the lovers by immobilising them. Helios supplies detection; the gods' assembled gaze turns capture into public evidence; bride-gifts and the adulterer's fine convert grievance into account; Hermes exposes the incentive by welcoming the bonds if they bring Aphrodite. The successful apparatus still cannot conclude its business. Poseidon risks his own liability as surety, and Hephaestus accepts the relation his trap cannot manufacture. The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/homer-1919-odyssey-murray|Homeric sequence]] passes from detection through capture and account to surety and release. The bonds can secure the lovers' bodies; the promise accepted from Poseidon makes their release possible. That distinct work of capture and undertaking carries the interpretation of counterfeit gathering and trust, while the narrative remains a particular quarrel and its resolution.

Taylor's [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|Symbolon Dynamics]] distinguishes synchronic co-presence from diachronic transformation. Both temporal views can retain relation or lose it. A completed change of perspective and the contextual holding of the perspectives together are likewise different operations. In [[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust|the trust-revision account]], a self never exhaustively coincides with its own representation, yet its life is constituted through encounters and coincidences. Self-reflection makes the self available as its own other; a returned encounter can bring a coincidence which that isolated reflection could not perform alone. The image becomes an idol when it claims exhaustive coincidence with what it images; determinate identity itself remains necessary.

## #5→0


Lacan’s cut makes differentiation consequential within signification; Taylor’s accounting asks how that cut retains or severs the relation it differentiates. Co-presence and succession can each disclose a retained or severed relation. The [language history](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT-language-symbol-dialogue.md#language-address) keeps the specific Lacanian attribution distinct from this cross-register comparison.


Heraclitus B51 holds differing agreement in tension. Its [transmitted philosophical account](../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/ancient-philosophy/DEVELOPMENT-ancient-philosophy.md#ancient-tension) preserves Mackenzie’s wording and distinguishes that relation from both tuning ratios and Aristotle’s qualified non-contradiction.

In Taylor’s [erased taijitu](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#erased-taijitu), each pole loses its internal other while opposed outlines survive. Their sharpening does not restore the plurality erased inside them. Signed cancellation and directed appropriation therefore remain distinct failures of the relation, alongside the slash which retains it. The [Necker-cube sequence](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) distinguishes successive reversal from contextual holding of the readings together: neither temporal office by itself determines whether the relation is retained. The erased dots perform Taylor’s alteration of the image; the loss is visible within each surviving pole.

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-native-relation) joins selection and gathering: attention distinguishes a jewel, then follows its constitutive relations without erasing that distinction. Polar relation, additive cancellation and directed appropriation remain separate operations. The simultaneous reflection and the reader’s successive traversal likewise retain different temporal offices.

Taylor’s corrected eagle in the [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-eagle-valence) carries signed power: `(-1)/(+1)` retains polarity, addition cancels, and opposed subtractions yield `−2` or `+2`. The shared body has to disclose which operation it carries. This keeps necessary distinction and relational recomposition active without treating a sign as a moral identity.

The [Valentinian Sophia–Horos–Achamoth whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/late-antique-gnostic/valentinian-sophia-horos-achamoth/WHOLE.md#valentinian-authorial-return) offers a comparison between Horos’s sustaining separation, the Aeons’ distinct contributions to the Soter, and cutting and gathering. The comparison asks how a sustaining boundary and a composed whole preserve difference and return. Upper Sophia’s restoration, Achamoth’s formations and the final destruction of matter retain their source sequence; destruction is not silently converted into noncancelling return.

The [historical matching token](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md#symbol-answers-to-source) retains differentiation across separation: matching requires the parts to remain distinct while their fracture makes a shared relation recognisable. The parties and institution determine what that recognition can warrant. In a present account, the source and the person or body standing for its use likewise remain distinguishable; returning to that relation makes the account answerable to what it depends upon.

The [bow–lyre tension](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-bow-lyre-hamartia) keeps release and gathering possible through a relation which does not abolish its opposed powers. Q27’s authored mark-missing-ground reading asks what a determination misses when it loses that relation. Heraclitus B51 supplies differing agreement; the lexical history of *hamartia* must separately establish the wording of missing the mark.

The [Ares–Aphrodite relation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release) holds Harmonia and the distinct Eros genealogies beside Homeric capture and release. The bond is loosened through an undertaking whose eventual payment the song does not narrate. The [Eros–Psyche union](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/eros-psyche/WHOLE.md#psyche-native-return) takes a different passage: four labours, descent, waking and acknowledged continuation, with Apuleius’s legal possession idiom retained in its account of union.

Taylor's [indelible-bond reading](../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond) gives cutting and knowing-with their shared genesis. The cut changes the relation; its claim to abolish that relation supplies the precise love/war fork. What was cut remains a condition of how the differentiated powers can meet again.

[Dia / Syn](concepts/C50-Dia-Syn.md) gives the pair its reusable form. Dia differentiates; Syn gathers without abolishing the differentiation. Neither cutting nor gathering is self-sufficient. The achieved relation therefore passes into process, symbol and encounter as a standing question: what must be distinguished here, and what relation among the distinguished terms must remain active if the distinction is to return rather than harden?

[Computational Process Ontology](A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) develops that consequence in transformations of a world; [Deferential Intelligence](A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) develops it where judgment must return authority to what it depends upon.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief|Agentworld]] tests the technical consequence through q029: a common decision-procedural grammar must preserve divergent world-models. Different premises must remain contestable; agreement is not evidence of a shared field if the method suppresses the difference which would test it. This is the essay's response to the brief, whose scenario modality at q042 remains intact.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD|Operational homology]] relates these passages through retained differentiation and return. Common lexical descent, doctrinal identity and empirical causal sameness each require evidence of their own kind. The Greek descent of *dia-ballein* and *sym-ballein* and claims about particular political formations therefore remain distinct historical inquiries.

[The Prisoner’s administered whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-asymmetric-count) retains the cut’s authority outside challenge. The Village distinguishes and recombines numbered inhabitants, yet the included person cannot thereby change the relation that counts him. The productive powers of distinction and combination remain real, while their source and return are withheld. Taylor’s reading locates the counterfeit reversal in this asymmetry between being counted and answering the account.

Three connected relations complete this return. Superposition belongs to the dual-non-dual ontology before its comparison with any physical formalism: ground and manifestation are distinguishable orientations of one appearing-act, each given through the relation that prevents either from becoming self-sufficient, and `0/1` and `1/0` write that co-presence in inverse directions. Quantum state space, complementarity and non-classical logics offer formal comparisons whose specific operations remain distinguishable from this ontological relation. [Priest's fifth corner](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/priest/priest-2018-fifth-corner/priest-2018-fifth-corner.md) and the catuṣkoṭi crossing in [Matheme](../../symbolon/matheme/definition/README.md) sharpen that comparison through their different treatments of the limit of predication. Second, QL supplies the usable attractor-space for the *pros hen* analogia by which mono–poly, subject/object, one/many, self/other, order/chaos and Apollo/Dionysus can be read together without being declared synonymous: its positions operate as transcendental attractors around which distinct mathematical, psychological, metaphysical, linguistic and technical expressions constellate. A taxonomic box would require identity of content; [focal relation](concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) instead constrains movement while preserving differences of register. Third, the political mass-formation reading brings [Le Bon](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/le-bon/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind.md), [Jung](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge.md) and [Desmet](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/desmet/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay.md) into a diagnostic relation, with [Iakovou's institutional qualification](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/iakovou/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism.md) constitutive of the claim: atomisation, free-floating affect, narrative fixation, excluded enemies and delegated responsibility can make the capture of the relating office feel like collective purpose. The one diagnostic survives every register: ask where the seam went. If it is externalised as enemy or silently erased through fusion, the relation has lost its ground.
